==Background==
"'''Issen Kounen'''" is a choir ballad produced by iyowa. It was released as a participating work in The VOCALOID Collection 2023 Spring event.

This song has entered the ''[[Hall of Legend]]'' and exceeded 2 million views on YouTube.
